service_identity.rule: Treat service name and region as deployment identity. Do not choose casually; moving later means creating/migrating to a new service.

recommended_usage: host Gemini-built React/full-stack presentation when a stateless edge is actually needed
typed gateway/proxy to Oracle/CACE only when materially useful
SSE/event fanout when it materially reduces Oracle load
static assets when already part of the deployed app
forbidden_usage: durable scientific workspace/run source of truth
background polling merely to keep an instance warm

deployment_pipeline.rule: GitHub remains canonical source. Avoid build/deploy per commit.

multi_user.durable_state_location: Oracle/CACE + approved low-volume Base44 account metadata

use_only_when: a public multi-user edge is materially needed
server-side auth/session callbacks cannot safely live in-browser
event fanout materially reduces Oracle/API load
approved production traffic requires edge isolation/scaling
prefer_not_to_use_when: the task would trigger frequent Cloud Build/Artifact Registry churn
